newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia trading system sets turnover record.
newsitem.headline: Russia trading system sets turnover record.

text.p: Share turnover on the Russian Trading System hit a record high volume of $46.97 million, the Moscow brokers association PAUFOR said on Wednesday.
The turnover figure is the highest level since September 1, 1995, when the RTS, an electronic system similar to NASDAQ, started operating.
The RTS index of 24 shares rose by 6.91 percent to 181.64.
